> caching, but I don't know what the defaults are.)

My approach to something like this is to set the lattice options in an
initial, uncached R block (often called "setup"), like

<<setup, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE, echo=FALSE, results="hide">>=
options(digits=5,
width=62,
show.signif.stars=FALSE,
str=strOptions(strict.width="cut"))
library(lattice)
library(ggplot2)
library(NRAIA)
library(NISTnls)
PurTrt <- subset(Puromycin, state=="treated", select=-state)
pm1 <- nls(rate ~ SSmicmen(conc, Vm, K), PurTrt)
PurUnTrt <- subset(Puromycin, state=="untreated", select=-state)
pm2 <- nls(rate ~ SSmicmen(conc, Vm, K), PurUnTrt)
rm2 <- nls(temp ~ SSasymp(time,60,130,lrc), Rumford, c(lrc=-4.5))
.f3 <- "%.3f"
.f2 <- "%.2f"
.f0 <- "%.0f"
#lattice.options(default.theme = function() standard.theme())
lattice.options(default.theme = function() standard.theme(color=FALSE))
@
